v008/v009, answering the v007 review: F1 the parapet's inside faces are drawn in 1 m pieces from the walking surface at each point, so no panel stands behind the slot windows; F2 slot windows stop 1.2 m below the walking surface above them (terraces included), checked on every reveal, glass and room vertex; F3 the pier is closed behind above the parapet and its holds stand 3 cm off the panel; F4 the summit flights run to the parapet and carry a glass guard and rail on their open side, joined to the upper terrace guard. P2s: the north corners keep the block's own radius down to the ground (F5); slot rooms 1.4 m deep (F6); the second flue winds 110 degrees round the first and both stand 100 m (F7); a dark pavilion roof, a turf pad at the foot of the climbing wall, slatted roller doors and louvres on the plant enclosure (F8); the wing coping runs right up to the block (F9). Festoon lights are not modelled.
findings: Massing: the oblique through the fitted camera matches the block, its sloped parapet, the rounded low end on the wing roof, the pier and the summit; the roof view through the orthographic camera matches the block outline, the turf and paths, the summit, the pier and the wings.

Openings: every slot window is cut through the wall, with reveals on four sides, glass 0.25 m in, glazing bars about every 2.6 m and a lit room face 0.9 m behind. The visitor entrance is a cut opening with framed glazed doors under a transom, a canopy and a lit sign; two roller doors in the north face and two service doors from the wing roof into the low end are recessed.

Roof: the turf, two stepped paths of 0.18 m risers, gravel edge strips, parapets with a glass guard beside the slope, a lower terrace with tables, a glazed bar with a lit interior under the upper terrace, short flights between the terraces, the upper terrace with a glass guard, a pavilion with lit glazing and rooftop units, and a plant enclosure. The roof is closed everywhere.
Climbing wall: the pier stands 5.3 m proud of the street front, its top following the parapet 2.5 m above it, with 26 large volumes and 240 holds in four colours.
Wings: 29.8 m high, green roofs with planting mounds, gravel strips along the block and round the stack, hatches, an upstand and coping; aluminium brick walls with course lines and slot windows.
Stack: twin flues merged, tapering, 100 m and 97 m, with dark flue openings, standing in a gravel ring on the west wing roof.
open_notes: Gate A: variant_0.png (the street view) is a grey render of the old LEGO model. A person must rule that the oblique and roof views govern, or supply a street view.
The roof view draws the stack leaning; the oblique shows it upright further east. The model uses the roof view's base position and the oblique's height.
The catalogue's suggested 160 by 70 m footprint does not hold the wings; the whole is 103 m wide.
The west and north faces, the wings' southern end, and all interiors are inferred.
